title: RawPoseFrame v1
description: One NDJSON record per completed inference call, including calls where no pose was detected. Backend, model, delegate, and topology metadata live in the session manifest and are joined by session_id. Landmark cardinality, ordering, timing sequence, and manifest reconciliation are validated by the Python reference validator. Unknown optional properties are tolerated so the contract can evolve within major version 1.

raw_pose_frame_schema_version.description: Semantic version of this artifact. It must stay constant across an entire NDJSON stream.

session_id.description: Identifier of the one session manifest this record belongs to.

frame_index.description: Index of the emitted record within the stream. Strict increase is a semantic rule.

capture_timestamp_ns.description: Monotonic capture time of the source buffer. Inference latency is stored separately so tempo comparisons stay valid.

pose_present.description: Whether the backend reported a pose. Records with no detected pose are still emitted, so dropout is an observable row rather than an absent one.

normalized_image_landmarks.description: Normalized image-space landmarks, or null when the backend supplied none for this call.

world_landmarks.description: World-space landmarks, or null when the backend supplied none for this call. Partial arrays are rejected semantically because they cannot be aligned safely.

image_width.description: Width of the image the backend consumed for this call.

frames_skipped_since_last_emitted_record.description: Camera frames received but not submitted since the previous record-emitting completed call; on the first record, counted from session start. Skips before failed submissions accumulate here rather than being lost.

allOf.description: A record with no detected pose carries null in both coordinate families rather than an empty or fabricated array.

landmark.description: One landmark exactly as the backend reported it. No smoothing, imputation, clamping, or conversion of confidences into booleans.

index.description: Position of this landmark in the manifest's declared topology.

name.description: Optional topology name, retained for readability only. The declared topology remains authoritative.

visibility.description: Backend visibility value, including low values, or null when the backend did not supply one. No numeric sentinel is permitted.

presence.description: Backend presence value, including low values, or null when the backend did not supply one. No numeric sentinel is permitted.
